title: Redstone crop harvester
description: The mod adds a redstone addition to harvest your crop automatically.
body:
Automatic Redstone Crop Harvester

A fully automated redstone crop harvester designed to power your fully automatic farms with minimal setup.

How It Works

1 Power the Harvester

Simply provide a redstone signal to activate the harvester.

2 Set Up the Collection

Make sure a hopper is within a 3-block radius of the harvester.

The harvester will deploy itself over the hopper to collect crops automatically.

3 Harvest Crops

The harvester automatically collects any fully grown crop within a 4-block radius.

No manual harvesting required.

Features

Fully automatic crop harvesting

Works for any standard Minecraft crop

Minimal setup: just power and place a hopper

Compact and efficient design

Ideal for both survival and technical farms
